content.text: Pingfan, I've been extremely busy with work lately, and Xingren is still in the recovery period and needs someone to take care of her. I really don't know what to do.
Don't rush, Chang'an. I remember you used an automatic feeder before; now you can try a smarter solution.
Look at this, smart devices can help you remotely monitor almonds.
Oh, this looks good. It has a camera and sensors to monitor the almonds' activity in real time.
Yes, you've used an automatic feeder before. The webcam allows you to check Almond's status anytime, and the air purifier can improve the environment and reduce allergens.
This is indeed a hassle-free solution, but while caregiving is addressed, what about rehabilitation? Xingren requires more meticulous care, such as taking medication on time and monitoring reactions.
On the day of your recuperation, you can hire a pet sitter for help. This way, you can ensure Almond receives professional care while you can work with peace of mind.
Pet sitter? Where can I find one? Is it safe? I'm a bit worried, especially since Xingren is still in recovery.
Don't worry, this platform is specifically designed to connect pet owners with verified sitters, so it's very safe.
Oh, that sounds quite professional. What types of services do they offer?
Look, the range of services is quite comprehensive—dog walking, home feeding, vet visits, and in-home care are all available.
I think in-home care service is very suitable for you. A nanny can take care of Xingren around the clock, ensuring the effectiveness of the recovery.
Hmm, in-home care services sound great, as they can provide more comprehensive care. However, regarding safety, I need to look into the details a bit more, such as background checks and user reviews.
Yes, the platform has a detailed verification process. You can check out user reviews, just like how we used to choose restaurants—compare a few more options.
Good idea. Pingfan, thank you for always being so helpful. From almond's medical visits to health discussions, and now to the current solution, you've really been a great help to me.
No worries, we're friends. Efficiency comes first, and if it can help you save time and effort, that's great. Remember our running appointment—don't be late on Saturday.
Haha, definitely not. Now that the almond issue is resolved, I can focus better on my work, and my quality of life can finally be a bit more balanced.
That's good. Let me know once the smart device is set up, and if there are any issues, I'll help you debug it.
Okay, ordinary, thank you again! Now that the care and recuperation during Xingren's recovery period are all settled, I feel much more at ease.
